# CleverSEO

> CleverSEO is a Finland-based software and WordPress engineering company. It builds CleverSEO for WP, an AI-powered SEO audit and fix-suggestion plugin for WordPress with a separate Premium add-on that applies and rolls back approved changes, and it also designs managed WooCommerce commerce platforms and delivers custom WordPress development for businesses.

## Company

- [About CleverSEO](https://cleverseo.fi/company/): Who CleverSEO is, its approach of combining proven foundations with focused engineering, and what clients can expect when working with the company.

## CleverSEO for WP

- [CleverSEO for WP](https://cleverseo.fi/cleverseo-for-wp/): Overview of the free CleverSEO for WP plugin (whole-site SEO audit, verified findings, AI-prioritized fix suggestions) and the separate CleverSEO Premium for WP add-on that writes and rolls back approved fixes.
- [Pricing](https://cleverseo.fi/cleverseo-for-wp/pricing/): Plans and quotas for the free CleverSEO for WP plugin and the CleverSEO Premium for WP subscription tiers, covering crawl coverage and monthly AI fix-suggestion limits.
- [Technical specifications](https://cleverseo.fi/cleverseo-for-wp/specs/): Detailed reference covering system requirements, supported SEO plugins, data handling, how verified findings and AI fix suggestions are produced, and the approval-and-rollback process for Premium writes.
- [Measurement & methodology](https://cleverseo.fi/cleverseo-for-wp/measurement/): A timed comparison of manual metadata and image alt-text work against CleverSEO for WP with Premium, with the test setup, results and limitations explained.
- [Apply for early access](https://cleverseo.fi/cleverseo-for-wp/early-access/): Application form to request access to CleverSEO for WP and a free CleverSEO Premium for WP subscription during the early-access period.

## Services

- [WordPress Development](https://cleverseo.fi/wordpress-development/): Custom WordPress and WooCommerce development covering technical SEO and performance, site repair and modernization, integrations and authentication, and purpose-built plugins.
- [Managed Commerce Platforms](https://cleverseo.fi/commerce-platforms/): WooCommerce-based commerce platforms adapted to a business's products, operations, payments and markets, built at launch and supported as the business grows.

## Contact

- [Discuss Your Project](https://cleverseo.fi/discuss-your-project/): Contact form for starting a conversation about a CleverSEO for WP, managed commerce platform, or WordPress development project.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://cleverseo.fi/terms/): Terms governing the CleverSEO service, the free CleverSEO for WP and CleverSEO Premium for WP plugins, and the paid subscription that enables Premium's apply features and updates.
- [Service Privacy Policy](https://cleverseo.fi/privacy/): How the CleverSEO service used by the plugin for the site crawl, AI site summary, AI fix suggestions, and Premium entitlement and update checks processes data.
- [Website Privacy Policy](https://cleverseo.fi/website-privacy/): How CleverSEO Oy processes personal data submitted through the cleverseo.fi website, such as contact-form enquiries and early-access applications.
